resource._comment: No criteria — Medplum cannot filter Binary by search criteria. Access is governed by securityContext inheritance instead: a Binary is readable only if the caller can read the resource its securityContext points at. Every Binary the voice service writes carries securityContext -> its owning DocumentReference, so a caregiver reads family-summary binaries and is denied note/transcript binaries (verified live 2026-08-01: family summary 200, clinical note 404). WITHOUT this entry Medplum returns a bare 'Binary/<id>' instead of a presigned URL and the family app cannot read summary text at all.
